252359|80b579b6.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
252359|80b579b6.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

252376|9f7cb8ed.name: Emerii Tallgust
252376|9f7cb8ed.text: Do you seek training as a leatherworker?

252478|1e95a038.name: Xy'aaria Streamrunner
252478|1e95a038.text: The skycutters and ferries haven't run in years at this point. For all we know, there are no other islands left for us to get imports from. Still though, I'm here... just in case.

253474|80396915.name: Peacekeeper
253474|80396915.text: That trainer can be found in a house near the High Order dock, on the southeastern edge of town.

253474|aa6ba0a9.name: Peacekeeper
253474|aa6ba0a9.text: Is there something I can help you find?

254345|1a6886aa.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257036|a6bb08a8.name: Baelann Favorbreeze
257036|a6bb08a8.text: Welcome to the Bank of Valanaar. We can secure your belongings and valuables here should you so desire. Do you wish to access your deposit box?

265654|32c7384b.name: Faladriaal Featherfall
265654|32c7384b.text: Welcome to the guild registrar of Valanaar. How may I assist you today?

267306|b66c2800.name: Umber Galestrider
267306|b66c2800.text: <The strider peers at you; its gaze is impatient and it almost seems to bounce with excitement.>

368-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
368-progress.title: A New Plague

375-progress.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?
375-progress.title: The Chill of Death

92579-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92579-accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $N.
92579-accept.title: To Valanaar

93927-complete.name: Constable Aonda
93927-complete.text:
So they are all dead, then. Storms curse these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.

I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?
93927-complete.title: A Last Request

94006-complete.name: Urs'endris
94006-complete.text: So, you wish to embrace the way of the claw, child? Very well. Let us speak.
94006-complete.title: The Great Ursera Spirit

94638-accept.name: Urs'endris
94638-accept.text:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.
94638-accept.title: Strength and Mercy

94638-complete.name: Urs'endris
94638-complete.text:
The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked.

You have done well, $c. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need.

Go now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.
94638-complete.title: Strength and Mercy

96897-progress.name: Hadric Harlson
96897-progress.text: I have a special disgust for living servants of the Scourge. They have the free will to walk away, yet the promise of power and immortality has robbed them of their reason and their morality.
96897-progress.title: The Cult of the Damned

97558-complete.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-complete.text: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.
97558-complete.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97558-progress.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-progress.text:
Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.

It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.

Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
97558-progress.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97955-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97955-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97955-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97955-complete.name: Nurse Neela
97955-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97955-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid
